description: Source-alignment record between the Claude skills in this repo and the Codex plugin port in email-love/codex-agents. Its job is to stop a fix from landing in one surface and silently never reaching the other. Update it whenever either surface ships a change that the other should mirror, and stamp lastAlignmentReview when you have checked the two are in sync.

codexPlugin.note: v3.0.1 ported the model-choice guidance (c0719be) and the Portsmouth batch 1 fixes (0c67f86) from the Claude skills. v3.0.0 originally repackaged the flat AGENTS.md workflows as a progressively loaded plugin with two skills.

drift.summary: Six more ESP source adapters added (Brevo, Kit, ActiveCampaign, Iterable, Omnisend, HubSpot), one per ESP verified via web search (Aug 2026) to have an official MCP. Each adapter written against public MCP docs and directs the agent to introspect the connected MCP's tools at session start since no loaded tool signatures were available to verify names. Per-ESP quirks named (Brevo full-account API key, Kit's three content pools, ActiveCampaign DND vs HTML, Iterable beta/self-hosted, Omnisend product-block placeholders, HubSpot smart content and CTA library). Step 0 now has 13 source options. Bumps audit 1.12.0 to 1.13.0.
drift.codexStatus: Not yet ported. The Notion port spec is now 4 commits behind (Portsmouth Marketo v1.11.2, CIO v1.11.3, cloud sources v1.12.0, these six ESPs v1.13.0). Simplest: wait until Portsmouth v2 fixes ship and port everything in one pass.

drift.summary: ESP migration v1.5: Google Drive + SharePoint cloud-source adapters added. Both use the same 'walk a location via MCP, pull HTML/EML/PNG, feed downstream' pattern as Local Folder. Drive adapter uses the reference Google Drive MCP with the drive.readonly scope caveat named. SharePoint adapter uses a Microsoft Graph MCP with the enterprise-IT-blocking-OAuth friction named. Step 0 gets choices (f) Google Drive and (g) SharePoint. Bumps audit 1.11.3 to 1.12.0.
drift.codexStatus: Not yet ported. The existing Notion port spec pinned to 48d085d does not cover this. Update the pinned spec (or write an addendum) before running through Codex; alternatively wait until Portsmouth v2 fixes ship and port everything in one pass to avoid churn.

drift.summary: ESP migration v1 commit 4: Customer.io Source adapter added (final adapter of v1 series). Uses cio_read_api + cio_schema + cio_prime. Directs cio_prime call every session, cio_auth_status for env confirmation. Names 'Automations in UI == campaigns in API' product-naming trap. v1 pulls Templates and Newsletters (customer picks one or both). Schema-first: use cio_schema to get current list/get shapes since CIO evolves the API frequently. Explicit v1 non-goals for customer transparency: does NOT pull Automations messages, Transactional, Design Studio emails, Layouts, or Snippets. Warns against reading CIO's own agent skills (design-studio, fly-api) mid-audit. Step 0 Customer.io load-reference stub updated to point to the real section.
drift.codexStatus: Not yet ported. All four v1 source adapters (local folder, Klaviyo, Marketo, Customer.io) now shipped on Claude side. Next commit is the Codex port spec (per new pattern: Andy runs the port through Codex against a spec doc, rather than me hand-porting).

drift.summary: ESP migration v1 commit 3: Marketo Source adapter added, prioritized ahead of Customer.io for an enterprise onboarding on Marketo scheduled 2026-08-05. No Marketo MCP exists, so adapter uses direct REST with OAuth 2.0 client-credentials: one-time credential collection (Munchkin ID, client ID, client secret, optional workspace), auth with token caching, list emailTemplates paginated by offset with status=approved sort locally by updatedAt, get emailTemplate/{id}/content, headless-Chrome render to PNG, design-converter worker. Rate limits (100/20s, 10K/day) explicit; adapter directs serial fetch. Marketo-specific report additions: template ID, direct edit URL, folder path, workspace. Named v1 caveat: pulls Templates only, not Emails or Content Blocks. Step 0 updated to add Marketo as (d), Customer.io renumbered to (e).
drift.codexStatus: Not yet ported. Wait for commit 4 (Customer.io) so all four v1 source adapters port to Codex as one commit.

drift.summary: ESP migration v1 commit 2: Klaviyo Source adapter added. Uses official Klaviyo MCP for discover (get_account_details + list_email_templates with -updated sort, pagination), fetch (get_email_template returning HTML, then headless-Chrome render to PNG, then design-converter worker). Deliberately avoids render_email_template due to its 3/s burst rate limit. Report carries Klaviyo template ID, direct edit URL, and editor_type per row. v1 pulls templates only, not campaigns/flows.

renderSpecIsCanonical: The render rules (structure.md and references/render-spec.md here) are the single source of truth. The Codex plugin carries mirrored copies. When a render rule changes, change it here first, then regenerate the Codex references rather than hand-editing them, so the two cannot disagree.
